title: 无人机快递
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished professional SIMPLE children's coloring-book illustration, square 1024x1024, for an Android tablet coloring game ages 5–12. Expert illustrator's warm expressive organic drawing with confident flowing curves, tasteful varied line weight and charming asymmetry; never geometric clip-art parts or a diagram. Make the main character or vehicle big, around 70–80% of the image, with a memorable playful pose and one clear amusing story beat. Only 10–16 LARGE enclosed white colorable shapes across the ENTIRE picture, hard maximum 20 including the background. Keep every colorable area broad and easy for a child's finger, no tiny enclosed islands. Use expressive solid-black simple eyes WITHOUT tiny white highlights, and open smile curves; large simple facial shapes. Omit decorative texture, fur tufts, narrow stripes, dense details, screws, tiny windows, scales, grass blades, confetti and background ornaments. Add only 1–2 BIG simple secondary props that support the scene. Background nearly empty WHITE, perhaps one broad sweeping ground/cloud curve and one large simple sun/star, never a detailed scene. Crisp clean bold BLACK outlines on pure WHITE: roughly 6px outer contours and 4px interior at 1024px, continuous CLOSED boundaries, generous blank coloring areas. No gray shading, color, gradient, hatching, sketch/construction marks, paper texture, text, logo, border, or watermark. Keep main subject and appendages inside safe white margins; no cropped character. Finished professional Q-cute children's picture-book ink line art: simpler linework and fewer bigger color blocks, lively and lovable rather than mechanically assembled.

Scene: ONE lovable rounded delivery drone proudly carries ONE big gift box beneath it, with an amusing slight tilt. A friendly large central body with solid-black eyes and an open smile; exactly FOUR broad simple arms, each ending in ONE broad simple propeller shape. Do not slice a propeller into tiny separate blades or add hub circles, motors, bolts or mechanical rings. The gift box has one broad ribbon crossing and at most ONE large simple bow, with no tiny loops or labels. Empty white background; no confetti, stars, clouds or city. Expert illustrator's lively flowing curves. Aim 10–16 broad coloring areas, absolute maximum 20 including background.

Final simplification: all shapes are a FLAT front/three-quarter drawn character, not a technical diagram. The four broad rotor shapes each consist of ONE simple closed soft dumbbell silhouette with NO inner circles or blade divisions; all arms connect seamlessly into the central body without joint lines. The gift is one LARGE front-facing broad white box, NO perspective thickness edge. ONE broad ribbon at least 8 percent of image width, NO thin ribbon stripes; omit bow if it introduces tiny gaps. Gift touches the broad underside of the drone directly, no hanging strings, cables, thin carrying straps or trapped wedges. Solid-black eye ovals, no eye white, and one OPEN curved smile stroke. Only 8–12 large regions including background; hard maximum16, each broad enough to fit a 7-percent-width circle. No additional props.

EDIT THE PROVIDED IMAGE ONLY. Preserve this joyful delivery drone, four broad propellers, friendly face, big bow and gift box. Simplify only these exact lines: (1) erase ALL four horizontal ribbon-edge segments on the gift, so the box has only ONE broad VERTICAL ribbon and two broad blank side panels, with NO horizontal subdivision anywhere; (2) erase the thin interior curved depth lines inside the LOWER LEFT and LOWER RIGHT rotor arms, leaving each lower arm a SINGLE broad white shape with no inner sliver; (3) remove the short head-bottom seam immediately behind the bow that closes the tiny WHITE TRIANGLE above the bow knot, letting that wedge merge into the large drone body. Keep all outer contours, eyes, four propellers, pose and professional drawing quality. No extra objects, no new lines or tiny regions, pure black on white.

EDIT THE PROVIDED IMAGE ONLY, a very small single change. Keep this drone, gift, bow, four propellers, all broad empty shapes and composition unchanged. Change ONLY the mouth from an enclosed open-mouth white pocket into ONE OPEN U-SHAPED SMILE STROKE: erase the straight upper mouth edge, leaving only the friendly upward-curved lower smile line, with the face plain white around it. No enclosed mouth or tongue. No other changes and no added detail. Pure black on white.
visualReview: Accepted after inspecting both original PNG and all numbered region masks: expressive simple professional line art; major subject areas closed and separate from background; no narrow mechanical rings or omitted excess regions.
